rationale: Both are extensive, well-grounded reviews with concrete file:line evidence; X is broader and more prescriptively actionable (explicit 'Change:' fixes, plus a genuine novel bug in the results[i]-fallback substitution). But Y more directly recalls the actual ground-truth concerns: it independently converges on the same request_batch_max_wait_ms regression david6666666/lishunyang12 discussed, explicitly validates the CFG-compatibility-key resolution asukaqaq-s raised, flags the same weak dp-rank-assumption test yuanheng-zhao called out, and — critically — surfaces a residual bug in the exact InlineStageDiffusionClient shutdown path that was the subject of the PR's most serious real regression, whereas X mischaracterizes that same code as a safe pattern worth copying elsewhere. Y's verification-style evidence (base-tree diffs, CI checks) also gives it a precision edge.
